scheme: <3,3,6;40> over Q (dyadic coefficients), the DPS-accurate variant of A. V. Smirnov's rank-40 scheme
files: 3x3x6_40_DPS-accurate_{L,R,P}.sms (hm representation: L is 40x9 (A, row-major), R is 40x18 (B, row-major), P is 18x40 (C, row-major))
credit: A. V. Smirnov, The bilinear complexity and practical algorithms for matrix multiplication, Comput. Math. Math. Phys. 53 (2013) 1781-1795, doi:10.1134/S0965542513120129 (rank-40 scheme); J.-G. Dumas, C. Pernet, A. Sedoglavic, Strassen's algorithm is not optimally accurate (ISSAC 2024) and Towards automated generation of fast and accurate algorithms for recursive matrix multiplication (arXiv:2506.19405) (accurate rational variant, data files). Files vendored unmodified; AUTHORS.md from the same repository.
